entities.name: Query protein (81 aa)
observations: The 81-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt references A5VI29 and B2G5K8 annotated as large ribosomal subunit protein bL31B.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 9.12 kDa and theoretical pI is approximately 6.26.
Pfam identifies Ribosomal_L31 (PF01197.24) across positions 1–79 with i-Evalue 1.8e-27.

entities.name: Large ribosomal subunit protein bL31B
observations: Curated references assign bL31B as a structural constituent of the ribosome involved in translation.
The protein is associated with the large ribosomal subunit; the available GO annotation is GO:0005840 ribosome, GO:0003735 structural constituent of ribosome, and GO:0006412 translation.

entities.name: Translation
observations: bL31B participates in translation as a structural component of the ribosome rather than as a catalytic enzyme.

entities.name: Ribosome
observations: The protein is annotated to the ribosome and is inferred to reside in the large ribosomal subunit.
